title: Graphical user interface system

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.
Family record identifies US12417011B2 as continuation-family member with the same graphical user interface title and application lineage.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: hosting multiple applications inside one main graphical workspace
presenting a primary application and minimized secondary application panels within the same window
switching primary focus among applications without losing workspace context
dragging data or resources between application panels
updating destination application interfaces in response to drag interactions
capturing interaction or transformation history for later visual presentation

scope_model.analysis_loop: render multiple application panels -> assign primary focus -> keep secondary panels visible/minimized -> detect user drag or transfer intent -> validate transferable resource and destination capability -> preview target state -> apply authorized transfer -> persist interaction/workspace history
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: use typed cross-application payload contracts instead of arbitrary DOM coupling
separate workspace layout state from application business state
provide visible destination previews before data transfer
make transfers reversible or auditable where practical
persist workspace composition and interaction history independently of any one application
enforce permission checks before moving protected data across application boundaries

independent_claim_themes: multiple application interfaces presented inside a common workspace
primary and secondary application window states
destination UI updates and transfer history

mandatory_safety_boundaries: preserve workspace and transfer auditability for sensitive data
